'''Sports coaching''' is the act of teaching the skills, rules and tactics involved in a particuliar [[sport]] to its players. This can be accomplished individually, by team, by division (ex. [[Defense (sport)|Defensive]] Coaching, [[Offense|Offensive]] Coaching, etc.) or by position (ex. [[receiver]] coach, [[quarterback]] coach, etc.) where applicable. Under this system in which duties are divided, there is a [[Head Coach]] who oversees all other coaches, as a [[supervisor]]. Coaching also entails the application of sport tactics and strategies during the contest itself, and usually entails substitution of players and other such actions as needed. In [[baseball]], the head coach is known as the [[manager (baseball)|manager]].

[[Coaching]] is accomplished by individuals referred to  "coaches" or "the coach," who usually are either individuals who have played the sport in question in the past or who have received [[training]] with regard to it.
